'''Cyreno Taegon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as the [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] at around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the company [[President/Legends|President]] [[Echari Di'San]] was arrested over the murder of [[Rysko Barnt]], this threatened the company's reputation, so Taegon met with the [[Heroes of Cularin]] on [[Dorumaa]] and hired them to find out the truth about Barnt's death and prove that Di'San was innocent.
